user.title: Connect to the bus GPS server
user.description: Traccar server address (e.g. http://your-server:8082) and login, as given by your bus company. If the address starts with http://, the login is not encrypted in transit.

devices.title: Choose buses
devices.description: Select the bus(es) to track. You can change this later by re-adding the integration.

error.no_devices: This login can't see any buses.

abort.already_configured: This server and login are already set up.

menu_options.add_profile: Add a bus profile (bus + stop + schedule)

add_profile.title: Add a bus profile
add_profile.description: Pick the stop on the map, or tick 'use bus position' to use where the bus is right now. Make one profile for the morning and another for the afternoon if the times differ.

data.name: Profile name
data.use_bus_position: Use the bus's current position instead
data.expected_arrival: Normal arrival time at the stop
data.offline_after_min: Alert if no GPS fix for N minutes (0 = off)

add_checkpoint.title: Add an alert checkpoint
add_checkpoint.description: When the bus passes this point heading toward the stop, an alert fires. Untick 'announce' to log it silently (shadow mode) and compare it with live checkpoints.

data.label: Label
data.use_bus_position: Use the bus's current position instead

data.show_panel: Show Bus Monitor map in the sidebar

error.location_required: Pick a location, or tick 'use bus position'.

reset_trip.name: Reset trip
reset_trip.description: Clear today's alert state for a bus profile so it can alert again.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile id (slug of the profile name).

suggest_checkpoints.name: Suggest checkpoints
suggest_checkpoints.description: From recorded trips, suggest where the bus typically is N minutes before it reaches the stop.

describe_location.name: Describe location
describe_location.description: Say where a bus is: the street, the cross streets either side, heading and time to your stop. Optionally speak it on a media player.

media_player_entity.name: Speakers
media_player_entity.description: Media players to speak on (optional, needs a TTS entity).
